observations.content: OrderService processes customer orders for the e-commerce platform. It validates payment, reserves inventory, and emits an OrderPlaced event.
OrderService is a Java Spring Boot application deployed on ECS.
OrderService depends on InventoryService for stock reservation before confirming an order.
InventoryService manages warehouse stock levels. It exposes a /reserve endpoint called by OrderService and a /replenish endpoint called by the warehouse system.
InventoryService uses a PostgreSQL database: inventory-db-prod.
InventoryService was recently refactored to use event sourcing. Stock levels are computed from the event log rather than a mutable row.
inventory-db-prod is a PostgreSQL 15 instance on RDS. Instance class: db.r6g.xlarge.
inventory-db-prod hit 92% storage utilization on 2026-03-28. An alert fired and the on-call expanded the volume to 500GB.
After the event sourcing refactor, inventory-db-prod's write amplification increased 3x due to append-only event log growth. The team is evaluating partitioning the events table by month.
inventory-db-prod connection pool max is 100. InventoryService uses 60-70 connections during peak hours.
The warehouse management system sends replenishment signals to InventoryService when physical stock arrives.
PaymentGateway processes credit card charges. OrderService calls it during checkout.
